name: 黑蝎-荆棘的美奈
desc:
这张卡给与对方玩家战斗伤害时，可以从下面效果选择1个发动。
●1张名字带有「黑蝎」的卡从自己卡组加入手卡。
●1张名字带有「黑蝎」的卡从自己墓地加入手卡。
faq: You can use "Meanae the Thorn"'s effect to add a Monster, Spell, or Trap Card to your hand that includes "Dark Scorpion" in its name, including "Mustering of the Dark Scorpions" and "Dark Scorpion Combination".
ruling: "Dark Scorpion – Meanae the Thorn’s” effect may not be used to retrieve “Don Zaloog.”
